title: Distinguish embedded host diagnostics from launcher fields and query refusals
outcome: Launcher diagnostics unambiguously separate host detail from launcher phase/category and identify GET refusals as query refusals.
acceptance: A host error containing phase/category keys cannot be mistaken for the launcher's own phase/category by the supported diagnostic representation.
A GET refusal after accepted POST is described as a query refusal; known status remains definitive and causes no execution/retry.
Relevant authorized tests pass with host-recorded evidence.
